title: My Home
text:
My name is Ana. I live in a small house with my mother, my father and my little brother. We have a red door and a big garden with many flowers.

Every evening we eat dinner together in the kitchen. After dinner, my father reads a book and my brother plays with his toy car. I like our home very much.

questions.text: How many people live in Ana's house with her?
What does Ana's family do together every evening?
What kind of home does Ana probably have?
Why does Ana say that she likes her home very much?
options: Because her house is very large
Because her family spends time together
Because the garden is always closed

vocabulary.definition: a place with plants and flowers outside a house
the room where food is prepared
a boy or man who has the same parents as you

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Ana. Eu moro em uma casa pequena com minha mãe, meu pai e meu irmão caçula. Temos uma porta vermelha e um jardim grande com muitas flores.
Todas as noites nós jantamos juntos na cozinha. Depois do jantar, meu pai lê um livro e meu irmão brinca com seu carrinho de brinquedo. Eu gosto muito da nossa casa.
